objectives.description: Confirm quarantine backups for existing chunks present
Confirm chunker overwrote chunk_*.md with decoded content, did not touch .bak-* files

deviations.description: literature-chunk.sh regenerated 140 chunks (chunk_0001.md-chunk_0140.md) from the decoded canonical, one fewer than the prior 141-chunk scheme, since chunk boundaries are recomputed from token counts of the (slightly shorter, post-normalization) decoded text.
deviations.reason: This left chunk_0141.md (the old 141st chunk) un-overwritten and orphaned -- not referenced in the regenerated chunks.json (verified: 140 manifest entries, 0 references to '0141'), and byte-identical to its own Phase-2 pre-decode backup (verified via cmp -s), confirming it was untouched stale mojibake, not silently corrupted. Quarantined it (renamed, not deleted) to chunk_0141.md.orphaned-pre-decode.bak-<TS2> using the same *.bak-* naming convention the pipeline's quarantine-hazard detection already recognizes, so it will never be picked up by literature-build-index.sh (which reads chunks.json, not a chunk_*.md glob) or any future re-chunk pass. Original bytes remain fully preserved in the Phase-2 backup regardless.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — re-chunk produced 140 chunks not 141; orphaned chunk_0141.md quarantined via .bak- rename, original preserved in Phase 2 backup)*
